name: Myeloid phagocyte activation and respiratory burst regulation
rationale: All members concern activation of monocyte/macrophage/neutrophil effector function, and the theme's positive/negative regulation of respiratory burst and superoxide generation (NADPH oxidase) sets it apart from neutrophil-degranulation, chemotaxis and killing confusables.

name: Axon guidance by ephrin, netrin and L1-family receptors
rationale: Members are growth cone guidance and fasciculation cues (ephrin, netrin/DCC, L1/CHL1, DSCAM, RAC1), distinguishing the theme from SLIT-ROBO commissural and chemorepulsion confusables.

name: Proximal B cell receptor signaling to second messengers
rationale: Members cover antigen-triggered BCR signaling through BTK, second messengers and RAS with its activation thresholds, whereas confusables concern B cell differentiation, proliferation or Fc receptor phagocytosis.

core: Germinal center and memory B cell responses
name: Germinal center and memory B cell responses
rationale: Members span Tfh/ICOS help, germinal center formation, CD27, B cell homeostasis and memory B/T cell signatures, unlike confusables centred on B cell development, proliferation or plasma cells.

core: Systemic blood pressure and volume regulation
name: Renin-angiotensin and renal regulation of blood pressure and volume
rationale: Members concern angiotensin, renal sodium/urine/glomerular control, vasopressin and peptide catabolism in blood pressure homeostasis, distinguishing them from nitric oxide/smooth-muscle and renal water-reabsorption confusables.

name: Post-embryonic eye development with vascular remodelling apoptosis
rationale: Two members are post-embryonic eye morphogenesis and one is apoptosis in blood vessel morphogenesis (as in postnatal ocular vessel regression), separating it from embryonic eye, lens and cardiac/endothelial differentiation confusables.

name: PDGF receptor signaling in fibroblast and stromal activation
rationale: Members regulate PDGFR-alpha/beta signaling, fibroblast proliferation and stromal/mechanoresponsive fibroblast programmes, whereas confusables centre on Hippo/YAP, ECM composition or TGF-beta.

name: Inner ear morphogenesis and vestibular function
rationale: Members cover otic vesicle, cochlea, semicircular canal, otolith and hair-cell development plus gravity sensing and vestibular reflex, distinguishing them from other cranial sensory organ and nerve confusables.

name: Chromosome condensation and centromeric CENP-A chromatin assembly
rationale: Members concern mitotic/meiotic chromosome condensation and CENP-A deposition at centromeres, unlike confusables about cohesion, spindle assembly and cytokinesis.

name: Glycolipid and GPI anchor biosynthesis and spastic paraplegia defects
rationale: Members cover glycosphingolipid and GPI anchor synthesis and glycolipid transport plus lipid-metabolism defects causing hereditary spastic paraplegia, separating it from catabolic, nucleotide-sugar and protein-lipidation confusables.

name: Nuclear pore transport, assembly and SUMOylation
rationale: Members concern nuclear pore complex assembly and nucleocytoplasmic traffic together with the SUMO conjugation cascade, distinguishing them from mRNA-export and nuclear envelope reformation confusables.

name: Dolichyl phosphate biosynthesis for lipid-linked oligosaccharides
rationale: All members concern dolichol/dolichyl-phosphate synthesis (including DHDDS defects) feeding lipid-linked oligosaccharide assembly, distinct from confusables on sugar-donor synthesis and other glycosylation defects.

name: DNA double-strand break repair by recombination and end joining
rationale: Members span break sensing, resection, homologous recombination (including BRCA1/2/PALB2 defects), NHEJ, SSA and MMEJ with ADP-ribosylation control, unlike confusables on replication fork, telomere and checkpoint processes.

name: RIG-I-like receptor signaling regulation and NF-kB activation
rationale: Members concern positive/negative regulation of RIG-I/MDA5 sensing of dsRNA and its NF-kB arm, whereas confusables focus on IRF-driven type I interferon production and viral evasion.

name: RB1-E2F and CDK control of G1/S transition
rationale: Members concern cyclin D/E-CDK activity, p27/p21 degradation and RB1-E2F binding at the G1/S checkpoint, unlike confusables on E2F target transcription or G2/M.

name: IL-10 family, type III interferon and IL-12/IL-23 signaling
rationale: Members are IL-10, IL-20 family and interferon-lambda plus IL-12/IL-23 signaling, distinguished from confusables by type III interferon and IL-20 family members.

qualifier: Tie2 and restraint of VEGF sprouting
name: Endothelial stabilization via Tie2 and restraint of VEGF sprouting
rationale: Members negatively regulate VEGF signaling and sprouting while Tie2, adherens-junction and survival terms maintain endothelium, unlike pro-angiogenic or cell-matrix confusables.

name: APOBEC cytidine deamination in RNA editing and viral restriction
rationale: Members concern C-to-U editing/DNA cytosine deamination and APOBEC3-mediated suppression of viral replication, with editosome formation distinguishing it from the HIV-restriction confusable.

name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven neutrophil chemotaxis and degranulation
rationale: Members concern neutrophil recruitment, chemotaxis regulation and degranulation with formyl peptide receptor responses, distinguishing the theme from respiratory-burst, extravasation and chemokine-production confusables.

name: MAPK signaling attenuation and atypical ERK cascades
rationale: Members concern ERK inactivation, negative feedback, phosphatases and the ERK5 and MAPK6/4 cascades, unlike confusables on RAS-RAF activation or JNK/p38-AP-1 signaling.

name: CHD-family chromatin remodelers and NuRD/ChAHP complexes
rationale: Most members concern CHD-subfamily ATPases and their NuRD/ChAHP complexes (with CSB-driven rRNA expression), distinguishing them from BAF, histone-modifier and nucleosome-assembly confusables; the emergence term is an outlier.

name: Sperm function, fertilization and germline-to-zygote epigenetic reprogramming
rationale: Members cover sperm maturation and motility, fertilization, piRNA/retroelement silencing, imprinting and the maternal-to-zygotic transition, unlike confusables on meiotic recombination or gonadal hormones.

name: Basement membrane-hemidesmosome anchorage and cornified envelope cross-linking
rationale: Members concern laminin/integrin/collagen anchoring of epithelia via hemidesmosomes and basement membrane, with cornified envelope and peptide cross-linking distinguishing it from collagen-ECM and desmosome confusables.

name: Tight junction regulation of endothelial and intestinal barrier permeability
rationale: Members regulate tight junction assembly/disassembly and vascular, blood-brain and intestinal barrier permeability, unlike adherens-junction, polarity and shear-stress confusables.

name: Cellular senescence with Polycomb silencing and SASP
rationale: Members concern oncogene-induced senescence, cell cycle exit, the secretory phenotype and Polycomb (BMI1) repression, distinguishing them from heterochromatin-foci and stress-induced senescence confusables.
